_notes: Design-day load-calc assumptions used by BlockLoadEngine. These were
previously hardcoded literals in the engine (Tier-2 item 2.4); they are
now project-tunable through the standard corporate-baseline + project-
subset of keys; unspecified keys keep the defaults).
The values below reproduce the engine's prior hardcoded behaviour exactly,
so a project with no override computes an identical load to before.
coolingDesignDoy   day-of-year for the cooling design day (ASHRAE July 21 = 202)
heatingDesignDoy   day-of-year for the heating design day (ASHRAE January 21 = 21)
outdoorDailyRangeK outdoor dry-bulb daily swing, K (CIBSE Guide A 2.4 default 8 K)
diffuseFraction    diffuse-on-horizontal as a fraction of direct-normal (0.15)
infiltrationWindwardCp  windward-wall pressure coefficient for the CIBSE
